user.title: D200 Deck
user.description: D200 Deck must use the same MQTT broker as Home Assistant. Pick the entities to put on the deck; you can change them later.

data.base_topic: Base topic (as in D200 Deck: Packages, Deck, MQTT)

error.invalid_topic: A topic without + or #, e.g. d200.

abort.already_configured: A D200 Deck with this base topic is already set up.

init.title: Entities on the deck
init.description: Each entity becomes an id you can put on any key with the app Home Assistant. Taking one off removes it from the deck.

data.default_actions: A press runs the entity's default action (toggle, run the scene, press the button)

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Shows a notification on the wide key.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: A Night Signal icon name or an emoji.

critical.name: Critical
critical.description: Stays until the key is pressed.

base_topic.name: Base topic
base_topic.description: Only this D200 Deck (when there are several).

set_key.name: Set key
set_key.description: Describes a key by id; put the app Home Assistant on a key in D200 Deck and pick the id.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Overrides the kind: an icon name or an emoji.

on.name: On
on.description: On or off, for icons that show it.

color.name: Colour
color.description: The entity's colour, for icons that show one.

clear_key.name: Clear key
clear_key.description: Removes a key id from the deck.

show_remote_page.name: Show remote page
show_remote_page.description: Shows or leaves the deck's remote page.
